summary.name: OpenSSH (usr.bin/ssh source tree)
summary.one_liner: CVS web view of the OpenBSD source directory for OpenSSH's ssh, sshd, scp, sftp, and related tools, showing file revision history.
use_cases: Review commit history of a specific ssh file
Compare revisions of sshd or ssh-agent code
Check recent changes to OpenSSH key exchange or authentication
Study implementation of the SSH protocol
summary.what_it_does: This page is a CVS web browser listing the files and subdirectories of OpenBSD's usr.bin/ssh source tree. It lists subdirectories for the ssh, sshd, sshd-session, sshd-auth, scp, sftp, sftp-server, ssh-add, ssh-agent, ssh-keygen, ssh-keyscan and related helpers. Each file row shows the current revision number, date, committing author and last log message. Clicking a directory opens it, and clicking a file shows its revision history and diffs between revisions. The listing shows recent commits covering topics such as post-quantum key exchange (mlkem768), removing the SSHv1 compatibility code, and switching ed25519 to libsodium.
notable: Official OpenBSD CVS web interface for the OpenSSH source tree
Per-file revision history and diffs between revisions
Licensed BSD-2-Clause per the awesome-selfhosted listing
caveats: This is a source code browser, not an installable tool; the page itself does not provide usage instructions
Listing shows only the current snapshot and log messages, not full commit content
